greet.text: A woman at the door of a flat-roofed house, a water-jar on her hip, empty. Two children watch you from the shade behind her. "If you're selling water, I've no coin. If you're from the Sovereign, I've less."

tally.text: "The Sovereign's due. Sixty gold a season to draw from the oasis, and my husband's ship came in light. Collector Amir took our tally-stone till we pay." She sets the jar down. "No tally, no water. We buy it by the cup from Nadira now. That lasts a week. Maybe two."

returned.text: She takes it in both hands and holds it to her chest, and for a moment can't speak. Then she fetches a small cloth purse from inside the door. "It isn't much. Don't argue. The children will drink tonight."

thanks_done.text: Samira's jar is full. She smiles at you over it.
